name: Brazil 1970 (FIFA World Cup, Mexico)
scopeNote: Brazil at the 1970 World Cup, six matches: Czechoslovakia 3 Jun (4-1), England 7 Jun (1-0), Romania 10 Jun (3-2), Peru 14 Jun (4-2), Uruguay 17 Jun (3-1), Italy 21 Jun (4-1), under Mário Zagallo. João Saldanha built the qualifying side and was dismissed in March 1970 (Jovem Pan: 17 March; Revista Oeste/ESPN: 16 March; 78 days before the debut); his work is context, not the profiled period. Style labels disagree: Zagallo himself said '4-3-3 anterior'; Coaches' Voice calls it a single pivot (Clodoaldo) with 'Five 10s' and a 4-4-1-1 low block; other sources say 4-2-4; the popular 'Five 10s'/joga bonito labels are partly myth (Gérson dropped deep, Tostão worked as pivot, Rivellino covered the left). Marking: no source describes Brazil's own marking scheme explicitly as zonal or man-to-man; the opposing man-marking by Uruguay and Italy is documented. Pre-tournament friendlies and qualifiers are excluded from evidence. Mostly Trivela's 2020 series, which reprints dated 1970 press interviews.
openQuestions: Brazil's own marking scheme (zonal vs man) is not stated in any read source.
Formation label: 4-3-3 (Zagallo), 4-2-4, or 4-4-1-1 in defence (Coaches' Voice).

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Piazza was a central midfielder who had been called up by Saldanha to play in his preferred position. Once Zagallo took over, however, he was moved back to play as a central defender. The idea was that Piazza's ability on the ball would improve the team’s build-up play from deep.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: The build-up started with Piazza, who linked with Clodoaldo or one of the full-backs – mostly Carlos Alberto on the right. Further forward, the team looked for its chief playmaker and often the deepest of the front five: Gérson.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Ahead of Clodoaldo, the team's single pivot, Zagallo selected a group of five attacking players who constantly interchanged positions.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: When facing more structured attacks by their opponents, Brazil set up with a much lower block and dropped into a defensive shape more resembling a 4-4-1-1.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: The back four would start a few metres from the penalty area, with Gérson dropping alongside Clodoaldo into a midfield two ahead of them. Rivelino and Jairzinho would defend the wide areas, leaving Tostão as the attacking pivot and Pelé ahead of him.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: a covering back line of three – both centre-backs and usually Everaldo, the less attacking full-back would push up as high as the halfway line. Clodoaldo would generally sit just in front of them.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: When they then won the ball back, Gérson was the player to whom they looked. A fine technician, he was capable of launching a quick counter-attack or holding possession while the team reorganised into its offensive shape.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: That left a lot of space in behind on transition. For all their offensive prowess, this was a team that conceded both chances and goals. The seven goals they conceded in six games is more than any subsequent World Cup winners have conceded in the 12 tournaments since 1970.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: He knew that the Mexican heat would make it almost impossible for teams to sustain high-pressing tactics against them.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Zagallo had built a team to defend with the ball, however.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: A back line of four was constant, with full-backs pushed forward to attack almost as wingers. The attacking midfielders in front of them moved from out to in, seeking goalscoring positions.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: A quick and efficient switch from one flank to another results in a stunning low finish from an advancing full-back.

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: “I want discipline and order, will and self-sacrifice from all of you,” he reportedly said in his first meeting with members of the team led by Pelé

sources.title: Mário Zagallo: The Tactical Masters - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Zagallo also wanted to compress the pitch as much as possible in the defensive phase.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A Alemanha Ocidental fica com o bronze e Zagallo detalha a tática da Seleção
sources.evidence: Não me afastaria um centímetro da minha ideia geral de jogo, que podem classificar de 4-3-3 anterior.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A Alemanha Ocidental fica com o bronze e Zagallo detalha a tática da Seleção
sources.evidence: Rivellino compreendeu que eu o queria na ponta esquerda, mas não como um ponta fixo, e sim alguém que executasse uma função de cobertura do setor.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A Alemanha Ocidental fica com o bronze e Zagallo detalha a tática da Seleção
sources.evidence: Em vez de vir tabelando com Pelé, deveria ficar na frente, de um lado para o outro, no sacrifício, porque Pelé voltaria para auxiliar o meio de campo.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A Alemanha Ocidental fica com o bronze e Zagallo detalha a tática da Seleção
sources.evidence: no meio de campo não ia mexer nem em Gérson, nem em Clodoaldo, a não ser eventualmente para aumentar o poder ofensivo do time, colocando Rivellino no lugar de Clodoaldo.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A Alemanha Ocidental fica com o bronze e Zagallo detalha a tática da Seleção
sources.evidence: Taticamente, o Brasil foi a única equipe, além da alemã, a saber explorar as jogadas pelas pontas. O sistema 4-4-2 perdeu, na comparação, para o 4-3-3 do Brasil e da Alemanha.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A Alemanha Ocidental fica com o bronze e Zagallo detalha a tática da Seleção
sources.evidence: Todos sabem que esta equipe foi por demais criticada antes de sair do Brasil, chegando a tal ponto que muitos dos jogadores perderam um pouco de sua confiança e, por que não dizer também, o moral.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial
sources.evidence: A Itália não alterou sua estratégia de marcação individual. Os três zagueiros “de combate” colavam nos três atacantes do Brasil. Pelé era sempre acompanhado por Burgnich

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial
sources.evidence: Por causa da marcação individual, Jairzinho mudou um pouco sua forma de jogar no Azteca.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial
sources.evidence: O repertório da Seleção acabava basicamente limitado aos cruzamentos de Carlos Alberto.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial
sources.evidence: Combinava uma qualidade técnica acima do comum, a inteligência tática na movimentação das peças e um preparo físico excepcional para enfrentar todas as condições no México.

sources.title: [Os 50 anos da Copa de 70] A apoteose do inigualável esquadrão: O Brasil é tricampeão mundial
sources.evidence: Nós nos unimos de todas as formas, porque queríamos mostrar aos incrédulos, ao sairmos desacreditados do Brasil, que somos uma geração de valor.

sources.evidence: Apesar disso, Zagallo não abriria mão da peça chave de sua engrenagem. E, na primeira partida contra a Tchecoslováquia, o camisa 8 estava entre os titulares

sources.title: Brazil, 1970 and the most beautiful football in history
sources.evidence: Carlos Alberto was instructed to bomb down the right flank when Brazil were in possession, leaving Piazza, Brito and Everaldo to cover for the whole team.

sources.title: Brazil, 1970 and the most beautiful football in history
sources.evidence: When in possession, they would swiftly play out the back and look for vertical passes to their attacking quartet.

sources.title: Brazil, 1970 and the most beautiful football in history
sources.evidence: Zagallo expected the Italians to man-mark his players as the Uruguayans did before. To counter their measure, he instructed his men to keep possession and constantly pass the ball around to exhaust the Italians.

sources.title: Brazil, 1970 and the most beautiful football in history
